# Maccaturo

> > Maccaturo is an Italian food experience platform offering Mediterranean Diet-inspired food boxes, culinary education, and authentic gastronomic journeys rooted in Cilento's UNESCO heritage.

Maccaturo combines food tourism, e-commerce, and culinary education to bring authentic Italian food experiences and slow-food traditions to customers worldwide. The platform leverages augmented reality and food academy features to create immersive connections to Mediterranean heritage, particularly from the Cilento region of Campania.

## Key Topics

- Mediterranean Diet
- Italian food experience
- Food Academy

- Campania
- UNESCO heritage
